articleTitle: What to Ask a Parent With Dementia While They Can Still Talk
imageHeadline: The Questions to Ask Before Dementia Takes Their Words
imageSubtext: How to capture what matters most while your parent can still answer
pinTitle: What to Ask a Parent With Dementia While They Can Still Talk | Mindful Caregiving
pinDescription: Primary progressive aphasia will eventually affect language and speech. Learn which conversations to prioritize now—the stories, memories, and details that matter most—while your parent can still share them with you.
